card.name: Just before 'plunger' in syringe steps
card.fires_on: The word 'the' or the start of 'plunger' (pl) right after verbs like push, pull, depress or withdraw in syringe instructions. It predicts that 'plunger' comes next.

modes.description: The word 'the' after a verb of pushing or pulling a syringe part, with 'plunger' expected next.
